findings.title: S1 pin 1 (GND_1) is on /ECHO, not GND
findings.why: The part names this pin GND, and the board has a net called GND. Wiring it to /ECHO instead means the pin is doing a different job than the symbol says it does.
findings.fix: Move S1 pin 1 back to GND.

findings.title: S1 pin 1 is a supply pin sharing /ECHO with the MCU port U2.39
findings.why: /ECHO carries both a power input and a general-purpose pin. Either the port is being asked to source a rail, or the rail is backfeeding the port through its protection diode. Neither part survives that for long.
findings.fix: Return S1 pin 1 to its supply net and leave /ECHO to the signal.

findings.fix: Stitch the VBUS islands together: vias between the layers where the pads are, and a pour on both.

findings.title: Decoupling capacitor for ULN2003 ground pin is 17.2 mm away
findings.why: Excessive distance reduces high‑frequency bypass effectiveness and can cause instability
findings.fix: Place a 0.1 µF (or similar) decoupling capacitor within ~5 mm of U3.8

findings.title: VSS pins have no nearby decoupling capacitor listed
findings.why: Lack of local bypass can allow noise on the MCU ground reference
findings.fix: Add small decoupling capacitors (e.g., 0.1 µF) close to each VSS pin

findings.title: Only one bulk capacitor (C12) is present on the +5 V net serving many pins
findings.why: Insufficient local decoupling can cause voltage droop and noise for devices powered from +5 V
findings.fix: Add additional 0.1 µF decoupling capacitors near each +5 V load pin

findings.title: Decoupling capacitor for AMS1117 output (C2) is 7.4 mm away
findings.why: Long distance may degrade regulator transient response
findings.fix: Place a 0.1 µF capacitor closer to U1.2 or add an extra local decoupling capacitor

findings.title: NRST pin lacks a pull‑up resistor to the 3.3 V rail
findings.why: Without a pull‑up, the reset line can float, preventing reliable MCU reset behavior
findings.fix: Add a resistor (≈10 kΩ) from /NRST to +3.3 V

findings.title: Enable pin EN of the TPS563208 shares the /IN net without a defined bias
